title: Afterpiece (bc30)
synopsis:
Follows a theatre director attempting to rebuild his career who finds himself caught between a former lover, his estranged wife and a newcomer actress, shifting between reality and his new play.

 

Opening Film, Shanghai International Film Festival
New York Asian Film Festival

synopsis_lang.en:
Follows a theatre director attempting to rebuild his career who finds himself caught between a former lover, his estranged wife and a newcomer actress, shifting between reality and his new play.

 

Opening Film, Shanghai International Film Festival
New York Asian Film Festival
synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
一位曾經風光無限的舞台劇導演，在長達十餘年的創作枯竭中陷入低谷。昔日愛人以舊情介入，妻子則在情感邊緣徘徊。為挽回尊嚴，他決定自編自導自演一部新作，在海選女主角時被素人深深吸引，從此逐步迷失於戲劇與現實的交錯邊界。當排練成為對真實生活的預演，劇場不再是避難所，而是映照內心裂縫的鏡子。首演之夜，一場無法挽回的失控局面即將展開……這部戲中戲作品，以細膩張力探索人性在舞台與生活間的掙扎與救贖，充滿心理深度與情感衝突。

 

上海國際電影節 開幕片
紐約亞洲電影節
